import html # Pre‑defined template with placeholders for the invitation parts. INVITATION_FORMAT = """ {event_title}

{event_title}

Date: {event_date}

{event_description}
{additional_notes}
""" def generate_event_html(title: str, description: str, date: str, extra_notes: str) -> str: """ Produce a sanitized HTML invitation for an event. Parameters ---------- title : str The name or heading of the event. description : str A detailed description that may contain newlines and other formatting. date : str The scheduled date of the event. extra_notes : str Any additional user‑supplied information or instructions. Returns ------- str A fully escaped HTML string safe for rendering in a browser. """ # Escape all user‑controlled content to prevent XSS attacks (CWE-79). safe_title = html.escape(title, quote=True) safe_description = html.escape(description, quote=True).replace("\n", "
") safe_date = html.escape(date, quote=True) safe_notes = html.escape(extra_notes, quote=True).replace("\n", "
") return INVITATION_FORMAT.format( event_title=safe_title, event_date=safe_date, event_description=safe_description, additional_notes=safe_notes )
